title_zh: 确认街道排水口堵塞的报修联系渠道

scenario.label_zh: 确认街道排水口堵塞的报修联系渠道
scenario.goal_zh: 区分国会议员选区办公室与地方议会职责，并决定先使用报修表、必要时再联系本区地方议员

context_zh: 虚构英国社区咨询，居民误向国会议员选区办公室询问道路排水维修。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: I live in this constituency. Can your MP arrange repairs to the blocked street drain outside my house?

sentences.speaker: Office assistant
sentences.text: Our office can point you to the local council service, but we do not schedule its repairs.

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: Would a councillor be a more appropriate person to ask about the repeated delays?

sentences.speaker: Office assistant
sentences.text: Yes. Your ward councillor has a public surgery on Friday. The council website lists the contact details and the maintenance reporting form.

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: I'll use the reporting form first and take the reference number to the surgery if the delay continues.

sentences.speaker: Office assistant
sentences.text: That gives you a clear record. Please check the surgery notice for any appointment requirement before going.
